segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jesus used a picture the crowd knew well — a sheepfold with one opening, and a shepherd who guards it.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Anyone who climbs in some other way is there to take, not to care.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: But the door? The door lets the flock in safe.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Through Him you come in and you go out — free, fed, not trapped. He's the way in, and the way to everything good.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: There's one door. Knock, and walk through.
